eventMetadata.context_description: The S&P 500 closed near 7,708 on August 19, 2026, after testing fresh record highs above 7,800 earlier in the month amid softer producer price data. Strong corporate earnings growth—projected at 10-25% for full-year 2026, led by AI-related capital expenditures—remains the dominant driver of market-implied odds for December levels. Resilient U.S. GDP growth near 2.1%, a Federal Reserve policy rate held in the 3.5-3.75% range, and contained but sticky inflation support the advance, though elevated valuations near 21-26x forward earnings and narrow tech leadership introduce downside risks if earnings revisions disappoint. Key near-term catalysts include upcoming inflation releases, labor data, and FOMC communications that could shift rate expectations and equity risk appetite.
